system.description: Touch a willing recipient and spend a Blood Trait to bestow the effects of War Cry, Wind Dance, or Fearless Heart upon her as if she had activated it herself. You may grant any combination of these to any number of recipients, spending one action and one Blood Trait per power per character. All normal limitations on these powers, such as no stacking Wind Dance, still apply.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait per power per recipient
system.duration: Rest of the scene (as the granted power)
